principle: A procedural cadet is a persistent person materialized from one real Academy population slot. Species, culture, origin, citizenship, personality, knowledge and academic state are resolved as separate concerns.
rules: The source population slot must exist and be latent before materialization.
Materialization consumes that slot without increasing cohort total_count.
character_id is deterministic from campaign seed + registry/group/slot identity + rules version, not from display name.
Species never directly selects personality recipe, morality, competence, branch or relationship state.
Name generation uses cultural/social/upbringing naming context rather than species alone.
Culture, citizenship and origin are not inferred solely from species.
Academy entry basis must already be valid for the era/campaign admission state.
Adult-equivalent status is mandatory; exact age is left unresolved if no valid species lifecycle range is available.
Prior education/interests/hobbies are context/evidence seeds and do not grant expert capabilities.
4th/3rd Class specialization remains null; branch interests may exist.
2nd/1st Class specialization must resolve from an already-existing latent academic state/valid branch pool.
New Academy relationship edges, classmates, roommates and schedules are forbidden in Step 2.
Generated cadet identity/personality/knowledge seeds are permanent after materialization.
Reserved/canonical display-name collisions must be filtered before identity is exposed.
